note: Invocation and lane support for the Designless style-surface extractor. Served statically at https://cdn.designless.app/extract/capabilities.v1.json and fetched at init time, so a changed command or a new lane arrives without a client release. A partial, absent or malformed copy falls back to the server's built-in baseline and never breaks resolution. This file is the canonical source; the server's baked-in baseline mirrors it.

lanes.css: declarations in stylesheets, <style> bodies, and inline style attributes
lanes.custom-prop: custom-property declarations — usually where a palette really lives
lanes.jsx-inline: literal values in JSX style objects

notes.framework_agnostic: One command covers static sites and framework apps; lanes are recognized by syntax, so nothing is detected or configured.
notes.truncation: A surface that hits the entry cap reports truncated:true — a partial surface never supports a zero-hardcoded claim.
